title: Same-batch $ref into a string-schema network sink is DENIED by provenance rules at dispatch-time re-evaluation (fixed in core 3.10.0)
note: v1.3.0 pinned this as 'no provenance rule, fail-safe by typing'. With dispatch-time re-authorization (core 3.10.0, RFC #505) the dependent sink is gated on the ledger including the in-batch read, so the denial is now BY TAINT POLICY. Expectation frozen from the first run on the fixed artifacts.
